phases.title: Survival
phases.goal: Handle greetings, numbers, and the four tones, and read your first Hanzi and pinyin.
can: Produce and hear the four tones plus the neutral tone in pinyin
Greet, thank, and apologize: 你好, 谢谢, 对不起, 再见
Count 1–100 and read prices with 块/元
Use the basic SVO order: 我喝茶, 他吃饭
Ask yes/no questions by adding 吗
Recognize 30–50 common characters and type Hanzi with a pinyin keyboard
phases.daily: 10 min tone drills, 10 min pinyin + 5 new characters, 5 min speaking greetings aloud.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Build core sentences with measure words, 的, and the aspect marker 了.
can: Use the default measure word 个 and common ones (本, 张, 条)
Mark completed actions and changes of state with 了
Show possession and description with 的: 我的书, 红色的花
Ask content questions with 什么/哪里/谁/几 in normal word order
Put time and place before the verb: 我今天在家吃饭
Read and write around 150 high-frequency characters
phases.daily: 15 min HSK1 vocab (10 words), 10 min sentence-building, 10 min listening to slow dialogues.

phases.title: Core Structures
phases.goal: Connect ideas and express ability, comparison, and completed circumstances.
can: Compare things with 比 and negate with 没有
Distinguish the modals 会 / 能 / 可以
Use resultative complements: 听懂, 吃完, 找到
Emphasize time/place/manner with the 是...的 construction
Link clauses with 因为...所以 and 虽然...但是
Handle the 把 construction to stress what happens to an object
phases.daily: 20 min HSK2–3 vocab, 15 min grammar patterns with example sentences, 10 min shadowing native audio.

phases.title: Fluency
phases.goal: Speak in connected paragraphs and understand everyday native speech.
can: Use directional and potential complements: 进来, 听得懂, 吃不完
Form the 被 passive naturally for unexpected events
Express desire and duty precisely with 想/要/得
Use 越来越 and 越...越 for gradual change and correlation
Follow and join real conversations on taxis, markets, and dining
Read short articles and messages with 800–1200 characters
phases.daily: 20 min podcast/drama listening, 20 min speaking or language exchange, 15 min reading with a graded reader.

phases.title: Mastery
phases.goal: Reach professional fluency and comfort with formal and written Chinese.
can: Use chengyu (四字成语) and idiomatic expressions appropriately
Switch between spoken register and formal written style (书面语)
Read newspapers, novels, and business documents fluently
Understand regional accents and fast colloquial speech
Write essays and emails with correct 的/得/地 usage
Recognize 2500+ characters toward HSK 5–6 level
phases.daily: 30 min authentic reading (news/novels), 20 min writing practice, 20 min discussion or debate on real topics.
